title: Knobly Roasted Greek Beef Gyro
description: A lazy Sunday Greek dish featuring roasted feather blade beef and crispy, crunchy texture from toasted pita bread and fresh vegetables. Perfect for a weekend lunch or dinner after a relaxing morning.

ingredients.name: Feather blade beef
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher to trim the fat and cut it into 5 cm cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, and salt. Add the beef cubes and mix until well coated.
Transfer the beef to a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, mix together Greek yogurt, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt. Refrigerate until serving.

To assemble the gyro, place a spoonful of tzatziki sauce on each pita, followed by a few pieces of roasted beef, some shredded lettuce, sliced tomato, thinly sliced red onion, and a sprinkle of chopped dill.
Garnish with additional dill and serve with extra tzatziki sauce on the side.
